info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Compute Engine API (v1) discovery document. Every other official method returns HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Networks, subnetworks, firewall rules, routes, disks, snapshots and instance templates are configuration metadata: no packet is routed or filtered, no VM runs and no block storage exists. Only custom mode VPC networks are accepted (autoCreateSubnetworks=false); no default network, default internet route or subnet route is created, and Network.subnetworks and peerings are not maintained. Disks and snapshots hold no data: sizes are recorded as given (blank disks default to 500 GB), a disk created from a source must state sizeGb, snapshots report storageBytes 0 and do not copy the source size, and customer-supplied encryption keys are refused. Instances are not simulated: instances.insert and every other instance method return UNIMPLEMENTED, because inserting an instance boots a VM; instance templates store the configuration only. References must name existing resources of this project; a resource still referenced (for example a network used by a subnetwork, a health check used by a backend service, or a VPN tunnel linked from a Cloud Router interface) cannot be deleted, and subnetwork ranges may not overlap within a network. Cloud Router and Cloud NAT are configuration only: no BGP session is established and no NAT address is allocated; MD5 keys, route policies and router appliances are refused, and NAT gateways need AUTO_ONLY allocation. HA VPN gateways, external VPN gateways and VPN tunnels are configuration only: shared secrets are refused and never stored, no IKE session runs, tunnels report WAITING_FOR_FULL_CONFIG, HA VPN interfaces carry no external IP address, and Classic VPN is not simulated. Cloud Armor security policies keep the rules given at creation (a default allow rule is added when none is given) because addRule, patchRule and removeRule are not simulated, and no request is ever evaluated; Cloud Armor Enterprise enrollment is not simulated, while policy settings such as adaptiveProtectionConfig are stored. Health checks, backend services, backend buckets, URL maps, target HTTP proxies and global forwarding rules are configuration only: no probe runs, no request is served, no address is allocated (IPAddress must be stated), backend services accept no instance groups or network endpoint groups, backend bucket names are not checked against Cloud Storage, and Cloud CDN settings are stored without any cache. Global forwarding rules use the Premium network tier; the project default network tier (projects.setDefaultNetworkTier) cannot be changed. Partner Interconnect VLAN attachments stay PENDING_PARTNER and OS_UNPROVISIONED without a pairing key because no partner exists; Dedicated, Cross-Cloud and Cross-Site Interconnect need physical links and are not simulated. Operations complete synchronously with status DONE and remain readable through zoneOperations, regionOperations and globalOperations get, list and wait.
